title: FrameSequence schema and validator gate
objective: 为 frame_sequence.v0.1 建立正式字段级 schema 与本地语义 validator，并让 video keyframe atlas importer 复用同一套校验逻辑。该任务不调用 provider、不读取 .env、不生成真实视频、不修改默认 runtime atlas。
acceptance_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
invalids = [
    'examples/media_frame_sequences/invalid_remote_url.v0.1.json',
    'examples/media_frame_sequences/invalid_provider_metadata.v0.1.json',
    'examples/media_frame_sequences/invalid_fixture_missing_review_only.v0.1.json',
    'examples/media_frame_sequences/invalid_loop_false.v0.1.json',
]
for path in invalids:
    result = subprocess.run(['python3', 'tools/media/validate_frame_sequence.py', path], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert result.returncode != 0, f'{path} unexpectedly passed\n{result.stdout}'
print('invalid frame_sequence fixtures rejected')
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
out = Path('/tmp/frontend_runtime_art_atlas_manifest.frame_sequence_validator_invalid_loop.json')
if out.exists():
    out.unlink()
result = subprocess.run([
    'python3', 'tools/media/import_video_keyframe_sequence.py',
    '--source-atlas', 'game_data/media/frontend_runtime_mock/frontend_runtime_art_atlas_manifest.v0.1.json',
    '--frame-sequence', 'examples/media_frame_sequences/invalid_loop_false.v0.1.json',
    '--output-atlas', str(out),
    '--spritesheet-output-dir', '/tmp/frontend_runtime_video_keyframe_atlas_sheets_validator_invalid',
    '--spritesheet-url-prefix', '/assets/frontend_runtime_mock/video_keyframe_atlas_sheets',
], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert result.returncode != 0, result.stdout
assert not out.exists(), 'invalid importer wrote output atlas'
print('invalid importer rejected without output')
PY
notes: FrameSequence validator 是本地语义门，不读取 .env，不联网，不调用 provider。
Importer 只能在 frame_sequence validator 通过后写 output atlas；负例 importer 调用必须失败且不留下 output atlas。
真实图生视频调用、provider adapter、默认 runtime atlas 修改和前端/后端运行时代码修改都不属于本任务。
